action.description: Skill action: 'create' writes a new instruction skill, 'install' adds one from a source, 'update' refreshes an installed one, 'enable' and 'disable' toggle one, 'validate' checks one, 'sync' synchronizes the community skill repositories, 'remove' deletes one, 'lifecycle_status' reports the lifecycle mode and proposal counts, 'lifecycle_list' lists proposals, 'lifecycle_inspect' shows one proposal, 'lifecycle_publish' publishes an eligible proposal, 'lifecycle_cancel' closes a proposal, 'lifecycle_rollback' re-activates an earlier revision, 'lifecycle_import_executable' publishes a reviewed executable bundle

description.description: Short description of the skill; required for 'create'

expected_generation.description: Active generation the caller observed; required for 'lifecycle_rollback'

name.description: Workspace skill name; required for 'create', 'update', 'enable', 'disable', 'validate' and 'remove'

proposal_id.description: Lifecycle proposal id; required for 'lifecycle_inspect', 'lifecycle_publish' and 'lifecycle_cancel'

reason.description: Why the proposal is closed; optional for 'lifecycle_cancel'

revision_id.description: An earlier published revision id, required for 'lifecycle_rollback'; for 'lifecycle_import_executable' the complete bundle hash the operator reviewed

skill_id.description: Lifecycle skill id; optional filter for 'lifecycle_list', required for 'lifecycle_rollback'

source.description: Git URL or explicit local directory; required for 'install'. For 'lifecycle_import_executable', the directory of the reviewed executable bundle
